description: NIST's FTC-10 (the committed real/nist-ftc-10), solid #6434: the closed convex edge between the cylinders f0 and f146, whose axes cross off each other, written as a cubic B-spline of 16 spans. The two cylinders meet in a quartic (the edge lies within 4e-4 of their traced section, its tolerance 6e-4), so no conic hides in it, and the closed edge has no ends. Filleted alone at r 0.5, the battery's radius from its sample today. Arris refuses it Unsupported(NURBS curve × cylinder surface); Open CASCADE builds it (plans/nurbs-face-blend step 1). The desired result is a walked stripe over the two cylinders' exact offsets
